_doc: Gen 2 (G/S/C) text encoding, byte (hex) -> string. Same family as Gen 1: 0x50 terminator, 0x7F space, A-Z 0x80-0x99, a-z 0xA0-0xB9, digits 0xF6-0xFF. Differences vs Gen 1 (English): Ä Ö Ü ä ö ü at 0xC0-0xC5 exist in the English font; contractions moved from 0xBB-0xBF/0xE4-0xE5 to 0xD0-0xD6; é moved from 0xBA to 0xEA; & at 0xE9; ← 0xDF, → 0xEB. Names are 11 bytes (MON_NAME_LENGTH / NAME_LENGTH).
